description: Foundation layers: the stdlib observability leaf, the domain-agnostic data_platform package, the governed semantic layer (markdown + schema.json + SemanticLayer), and the four synthetic data CSVs. These are the lowest layers everything else depends on (dependency graph points downward: orchestration/concierge -> {semantic, data_platform} -> observability). No Strands/Bedrock dependency — all stdlib. Independent of FEAT-002/003 except as their prerequisite.
steps: Create observability/ leaf package per design section 4.1: observability/tracing.py with the exact span(name, **fields) contextmanager (true no-op when _ENABLED is false — yields immediately with no logging/timing), is_enabled(), set_enabled(flag), span_count() (counts tool.* spans), configure_logging(), and the OBSERVABILITY env flag. observability/__init__.py re-exports span, is_enabled, set_enabled, span_count, configure_logging and carries the design section 1 docstring verbatim ('Stdlib leaf: a span/timing context manager and an enable flag, no-op when disabled...').

Create data/ CSVs by copying the four reference CSVs VERBATIM from C:\Users\evaleah\amazon.com\AWE RTP - Documents\2026 All Things Open\ATO2026_Working_Materials_2026-10-07_v1\ATO2026_Working_Materials\semantic-layer-agent\data\{sessions,tracks,speakers,rooms}.csv. CRITICAL: S10 keeps room_id=Main in sessions.csv; rooms.csv keeps only rooms A/B/C/D (NO 'Main' row).

Create data_platform/ package per design sections 2.1-2.5 (code blocks are near-verbatim): types.py (Row=dict[str,str], frozen SourceSpec {id,kind,location,grain,description,options}, frozen SourceError {error, source_id}); connectors.py (Connector Protocol, CsvConnector.read with path-confinement check that rejects locations escaping the resolved data root, CONNECTORS={'csv':CsvConnector()}, register_connector); catalog.py (Catalog + Catalog.from_schema(list[dict]) -> SourceSpecs, ids/get/__contains__); platform.py (DataPlatform with list_sources, list_source_ids, get_source returning SourceSpec|SourceError, read_rows returning list[Row]|SourceError, validating id against catalog and wrapping connector exceptions in SourceError); __init__.py re-exporting DataPlatform/Catalog/SourceSpec/Row/SourceError/Connector/CsvConnector/register_connector and defining build_platform(schema, base_dir). Keep the package docstring from design section 1. No conference vocabulary anywhere in this package.

Create semantic/ package per design sections 2.6 and 8: copy sources.md/field_map.md/joins.md near-verbatim from the reference semantic_layer/ dir, bumping each '# version:' marker to 0.2 (keep sources.md's trailing prose on its version line: '# version: 0.2  (add a source by adding a row here — no agent code changes)'); keep joins.md's three keys and correctness rules unchanged. Add schema.json exactly as design section 8 (version '0.2', four sources with kind/location/grain/description, three joins). Add layer.py with the SemanticLayer class exactly as design section 2.6 (served_text() joining the three md files with '

---

' and caching; schema() -> schema.json['sources']; joins() -> schema.json['joins']; version() -> str(schema.json['version']); reload() clearing both caches; _load()). __init__.py re-exports SemanticLayer and carries the design section 1 docstring.
acceptance_criteria: observability import + no-op: `python -c "from observability import span, is_enabled; assert is_enabled() in (True,False);` with observability disabled, `with span('x'): pass` yields and logs nothing` -> runs clean.
data invariants hold: rooms.csv has no 'Main' room_id and sessions.csv S10 has room_id='Main'.

data_platform works and is domain-agnostic: build_platform + read_rows returns a non-empty list for a known source and a SourceError for an unknown id; grepping data_platform/*.py finds none of the words session/track/room/speaker as domain concepts in the public interface.
semantic layer serves and versions: SemanticLayer.served_text() contains 'Source Catalog' and 'Join Semantics' and 'session_id'; version()=='0.2'; schema() lists the four sources.
verification:
python -c "from observability import span, is_enabled, set_enabled; set_enabled(False);
from contextlib import suppress
with span('t'): pass
print('obs ok')"

python -c "import csv; r=[x['room_id'] for x in csv.DictReader(open('data/rooms.csv'))]; assert 'Main' not in r, r; s={x['session_id']:x for x in csv.DictReader(open('data/sessions.csv'))}; assert s['S10']['room_id']=='Main'; print('data ok')"

python -c "from data_platform import build_platform; from pathlib import Path; p=build_platform([{'id':'rooms','location':'data/rooms.csv'}], Path('.')); rows=p.read_rows('rooms'); assert isinstance(rows,list) and rows; err=p.read_rows('nope'); print(type(err).__name__)"  # expect SourceError

python -c "from semantic import SemanticLayer; from pathlib import Path; L=SemanticLayer(Path('semantic')); t=L.served_text(); assert 'Source Catalog' in t and 'Join Semantics' in t and 'session_id' in t; assert L.version()=='0.2'; assert {s['id'] for s in L.schema()}=={'sessions','tracks','speakers','rooms'}; print('semantic ok')"
findings:
All four FEAT-001 verification commands pass (obs ok / data ok / SourceError / semantic ok). Repo initialized (git init) on branch feat-001-foundation-layers; committed locally, NOT pushed. .gitignore added at project root (ignores __pycache__, *.py[cod], .env, build.log).

IMPORT PATHS for later FEATs:
- observability: `from observability import span, is_enabled, set_enabled, span_count, configure_logging`. span is a @contextmanager; true no-op when disabled (yields immediately). span_count() counts only names starting with 'tool.'. OBSERVABILITY env flag enables at import; set_enabled(bool) toggles at runtime.
- data_platform: `from data_platform import build_platform, DataPlatform, Catalog, SourceSpec, Row, SourceError, Connector, CsvConnector, register_connector`. SourceError also importable from `data_platform.types import SourceError` (used by enrichment per design 3.3). build_platform(schema, base_dir) where schema is list[dict] (use SemanticLayer(...).schema()) and base_dir is a Path (project root). read_rows/get_source RETURN SourceError (never raise) for unknown ids/path-escape/missing file/unknown kind. list_source_ids() for the tool-boundary validator.
- semantic: `from semantic import SemanticLayer`. Construct as SemanticLayer(Path(.../'semantic')). served_text() joins the 3 md files with '\n\n---\n\n' and caches; schema()->schema.json['sources'] (4 sources); joins()->schema.json['joins'] (3); version()=='0.2'; reload() clears both caches.

INVARIANTS confirmed: rooms.csv has rooms A/B/C/D only (NO 'Main'); sessions.csv S10 room_id='Main' (the TBD gap). CSVs copied byte-verbatim from the reference. S06 anchors (track_id=ai, room_id=C, session_id=S06, speaker Sam Okoye) and S05 (ai, C, Tue) present in the carried data for later FEAT eval checks.

DEVIATIONS: none from the design. Note: data_platform/types.py line comment `id: str  # catalog id, e.g. "sessions"` contains the word 'sessions' as an illustrative example only (carried verbatim from design 2.1); it is a comment, not public-interface vocabulary, so the domain-agnostic criterion holds. The data_platform/__init__.py docstring uses design section-1 verbatim wording (not the shorter 2.5 variant), per the FEAT instruction to keep the section-1 package docstring.

SemanticLayer path convention used by callers: pass the semantic/ dir Path. Project root is the directory containing data/, semantic/, data_platform/, observability/ (the step cwd).
